g.text: G = canonical game-shape groups; original all-method common support. CI > 0 / < 0 / spans 0 describes the saved paired 95% interval; CI NA = unavailable.

g.text: Intervals are descriptive, unadjusted for multiplicity, and conditional on fixed fitted forecasts. Colors saturate at ±0.35; printed values are exact to rounding.
